title: Termination deletion language needs strengthening
description: The draft support agreement covers return or deletion generally but does not require a dated deletion certificate or defined deletion window after termination.
recommendation: Add a 30 day deletion deadline and deletion certificate obligation to the DPA.

title: Transfer impact assessment requires refresh
description: The existing transfer assessment predates MarketReach's new analytics module and does not document supplementary measures for campaign engagement data.
recommendation: Refresh the TIA, confirm encryption and access controls, and attach it to the executed SCC package before expanded use.

title: Controller-like reuse language in analytics addendum
description: The addendum allows vendor benchmarking language that is too broad for a pure processor relationship and may permit reuse beyond Acme instructions.
recommendation: Amend the addendum so campaign execution data is processed only on Acme instructions and aggregated benchmarking excludes identifiable customer data.

title: Inactive profile retention exceeds Acme policy
description: Default vendor settings retain inactive contacts for 36 months, exceeding Acme's 24 month retention standard for marketing profiles.
recommendation: Reduce inactive retention to 24 months or implement automated suppression and deletion workflow.
